sections.Profile:
Collect all six actors who have played James Bond, battle villains from the franchise's 25 films and earn gadgets in this retro-styled Keith Elwin design, made at the request of the films' licensor. The single-level playfield has no ramps and centers on Oddjob's spinning hat above an embedded LCD screen, while scores run on mechanical reels in the backbox.

- Manufacturer: Stern Pinball Inc.
- Years made: 2023
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: James Bond, 2020s, Licensed, Solid State, Single level playfield, Action
